record.question: Who is the new Chief Justice of India?
record.explanation: Answer C: Justice Surya Kant. Justice Surya Kant became the 53rd Chief Justice of India in November 2025; the answer is anchored to the January 2026 exam date. Reference: https://www.sci.gov.in/chief-justice-judges/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
